name: agents-stream
description: Review AI file edits as diffs and run AI CLIs in an embedded terminal.

agents-check.supportedFileDetectionMode.description: Controls whether Agents Check uses its built-in text file rules together with agents-check.includedPaths, or only includedPaths.

agents-check.includedPaths.markdownDescription: Extra files to track for AI edits - a baseline is kept and edits open a diff - on top of the built-in list (`.ts`, `.py`, `.md`, `Dockerfile`, …). Uses `.gitignore` syntax, one pattern per entry, matched relative to each workspace folder's root.

agents-check.supportedFileExtensions.description: Additional file extensions that Agents Check should treat as text files.
agents-check.supportedFileExtensions.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: use agents-check.includedPaths (.gitignore syntax) instead. Still read for now.

agents-check.supportedFilenames.description: Additional exact filenames that Agents Check should treat as text files.
agents-check.supportedFilenames.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: use agents-check.includedPaths (.gitignore syntax) instead. Still read for now.

agents-check.supportedFilenamePatterns.description: Additional filename glob patterns that Agents Check should treat as text files.
agents-check.supportedFilenamePatterns.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: use agents-check.includedPaths (.gitignore syntax) instead. Still read for now.

agents-check.maxFileLines.markdownDescription: Advanced: ignore files longer than this many lines - no baseline is kept and no diff tab ever opens for them. Set to `0` to disable the limit.

agents-check.excludedPaths.markdownDescription: Paths that are never tracked - no baseline, no diff. Uses `.gitignore` syntax relative to each workspace folder's root.

agents-check.respectGitignore.markdownDescription: Never track files ignored by git - no baseline, no diff.

agents-check.baselineScanConcurrency.description: Advanced: maximum number of files read concurrently during the initial baseline scan.

agents-check.burstDetectionEnabled.description: Advanced: when many files change within a short window, hold files beyond the threshold to confirm a git operation before treating them as AI edits.

agents-check.burstDetectionWindowMs.description: Advanced: sliding time window (ms) for burst detection.

agents-check.burstDetectionThreshold.description: Advanced: number of distinct files changed within the burst window that counts as a batch operation.

agents-check.burstDetectionHoldMs.description: Advanced: how long (ms) to hold burst-threshold-exceeding files if no git branch change is confirmed.

agents-boxes.preventAltMenuFocus.description: Keep focus in the terminal after Alt+Tab by setting window.customMenuBarAltFocus to false.

commands.title: Agents Check: Accept All Changes (All Files)
